subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should this PR wait for a real Discord conflict-to-retry or conflict-to-redelivery trace, or should a maintainer explicitly override the external-PR proof gate based on the focused tests and green CI?
rationale: Tests establish the internal branches, but only a real Discord setup can demonstrate transport redelivery and exact-once user-visible behavior for this timing-sensitive message-loss fix.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted live run shows the same-thread message retries or redelivers once without silent loss or duplication.

options.title: Override with test evidence
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused handler and replay-queue tests plus green CI as sufficient for this timing-sensitive fix.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
